description: No exit primitive exists in runtime/src. Drivers return to the CLI which calls exit (cli.rs:48-63); AOT fz_aot_run_main returns 0/1 (runtime/src/aot_shim.rs:617-623). System.halt(n) must stop the scheduler, flush stdout (Rust LineWriter is not flushed by process::exit), and exit with n. Used by the distiller's check! on a census mismatch.
title: System.halt/1 sets the exit status on all three paths
